name: MindfulOpus Podcast
tagline: Where classical musicians drop the grind and lean into well-being
description: Welcome to the MindfulOpus Podcast — where your artistry doesn't have to come at the cost of your humanity. I'm your host, Jo Zakany — former violist with The Cleveland Orchestra, yoga teacher, and coach for classical musicians. Here, we see well-being as essential to creating the life you love, on and off stage. Through honest conversations, reflections, and sharing tools you can use, we'll explore how to thrive as a musician — so your art shines, performing stays fun, and you can kick toxic grind culture to the curb. Time to drop the grind, and lean into well-being… I'm so glad you're here, and let's get to it!

host.name: Jo Zakany
host.bio: Former violist with The Cleveland Orchestra, yoga teacher, and coach for classical musicians. Helping performers thrive on and off stage by kicking toxic grind culture to the curb.
